# Pinaxium: local image generation (ComfyUI) — MCP reference

<!-- generated by tools_docs.py from the live server; edit the code, then run `uv run python tools_docs.py` -->

Server `pinaxium` version 0.5.0, protocol 2025-11-25.

## Instructions sent to clients

These are delivered to the client at connection time; agents see them as the server's usage guide.

> Pinaxium generates and edits images locally on this machine's GPU through ComfyUI. Nothing leaves the machine (except via run_workflow, see below).
> 
> Workflow:
> 1. list_models: pick a model by its capabilities and notes (speed, lettering quality, editing, transparency). Omit `model` to use the default.
> 2. generate_image (text to image) or edit_image (change an image, or compose from several reference images; only models with capabilities.edit).
> 3. Check the result before presenting it: the reply carries the saved path, a pinaxium:// resource link to the full-size PNG and a preview. Use view_image with crop to inspect lettering, hands or faces at full resolution.
> When you show the user an image, give them a link they can click: the `open:` file:/// link (opens the file from this machine's disk) and, when present, the `browser:` http://127.0.0.1 link (opens in any browser on this machine, also where file links are blocked). Listings and finalize results carry the same as file_uri and local_url.
> 4. Iterate: the reply reports the seed; reuse it with a changed prompt for controlled variations, or omit it for new ones.
> 5. Finish: finalize_image the keeper(s), then delete_images the leftover drafts.
> 
> Projects: pass `project` (e.g. "logo-redesign") to keep a piece of work together; without it, work goes to "scratch". Every render is a draft (pinaxium://projects/<project>/drafts/<file>) recorded with its prompt, model and seed. finalize_image turns a draft into a final with a permanent id and URI (pinaxium://projects/<project>/finals/<id>, e.g. .../finals/portrait-001) plus a title, description and tags for search. Refer to images by these URIs, not file paths: finals resolve through Pinaxium even after their files are renamed or moved. Finals are never deleted or overwritten; delete_images sends drafts to the recycle bin (one by one, or a whole project's).
> 
> Reuse: list_finals searches finished artwork across projects (paginated metadata; thumbnails=true adds one numbered contact sheet whose tile #n is the entry with sheet_number n); get_final shows one at higher resolution; derive_from_final starts a new draft from a final, in its project or any other; any draft or final URI also works as an edit_image reference. list_projects and list_drafts show the rest.
> 
> Prompting: detailed natural-language descriptions work best (subject, setting, style, lighting, composition). Put text that must appear in the image in quotes. negative_prompt only matters when cfg_scale > 1; the distilled/turbo models run at 1.
> 
> Timing: the engine is stopped while idle. The first request starts it (about 10-20 s) and loads the model; switching models reloads. Renders run one at a time, shared with other clients. Time grows with pixel count and steps: prefer 1024x1024-class sizes and turbo/distilled models for drafts. If a render outlives max_wait_s you get a job_id: collect it with get_job.
> 
> When something fails: tool errors say what to fix. engine_status reports setup_problems (and the config file) when the engine can't start; the pinaxium://logs/comfyui resource shows ComfyUI's own errors.
> 
> Engine control: stop_engine frees all GPU memory now (it also ends other clients' renders); free_vram unloads models but keeps the engine; it stops by itself after the configured idle time.
> 
> run_workflow runs an arbitrary ComfyUI graph and is open-world: partner API nodes call paid external services and custom nodes can run any code. Use it only when the built-in tools can't do the job and the user wants it.

### engine_status

**Engine status**

Report whether the engine is stopped, starting, ready to render, or external (a ComfyUI this server didn't start, which it uses but never stops), plus GPU memory, whether models are loaded, the queue, idle time, the config file in use and, if the engine can't start, setup_problems saying how to fix them. Never starts the engine.

No parameters.

Structured result (`structuredContent`; the same JSON is also sent as text):

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `engine_url` | string | ComfyUI HTTP endpoint the engine uses |
| `idle_shutdown_minutes` | number | The engine stops after this long without requests or jobs |
| `status` | `stopped` \| `starting` \| `ready` \| `external` | stopped: not running (starts on the next request); starting: booting; ready: running and started by this server; external: a ComfyUI this server didn't start is on the port, used but never shut down |
| `ready_to_render` | boolean | True when renders can be submitted now (status ready or external) |
| `busy` | boolean \| null | A render is running (only while the engine is up) |
| `queued_jobs` | integer \| null | Jobs waiting behind the running one |
| `gpu` | string \| null | GPU name as ComfyUI reports it |
| `vram_used_gb` | number \| null | Whole-GPU memory in use by all processes, GB |
| `vram_total_gb` | number \| null | Total GPU memory, GB |
| `comfyui_version` | string \| null | Version of the running ComfyUI |
| `models_loaded_estimate` | boolean \| null | True when GPU memory beyond the engine's idle baseline suggests models are loaded (an estimate: other programs' GPU memory counts too) |
| `vram_used_by_models_gb` | number \| null | GPU memory above the idle engine's baseline, GB |
| `idle_minutes` | number \| null | Minutes since the last request (managed engine only) |
| `last_stop_reason` | string \| null | Why the engine last stopped, e.g. idle, stop requested, or a startup failure |
| `note` | string \| null | Extra information about the engine's state |
| `config_file` | string \| null | Settings file in use (see `python -m pinaxium.config`) |
| `setup_problems` | array of string \| null | What prevents the engine from starting, and how to fix it |

**Start engine**

Start the engine now (otherwise it starts on the first render) and wait until it is ready to render. Models load into VRAM on the first render, not here. Does nothing if it is already running.

No parameters.

### stop_engine

**Stop engine**

Shut the engine down now and release all GPU memory. It restarts on the next request. A running render and queued jobs are lost, including other clients' (the engine is shared). A ComfyUI this server didn't start is left running.

No parameters.

### free_vram

**Free GPU memory**

Unload models from GPU and system memory (and clear ComfyUI's node cache) but keep the engine running; the next render reloads them.

No parameters.

### list_models

**List image models**

List the image models found in ComfyUI's model folders, default model first: each one's id (pass it as `model`), family, capabilities (editing, reference-image limit, transparency, lettering quality, largest size), default steps/cfg, notes comparing it with the others, files and license; models that can't be used yet and what they are missing; and other files found (LoRAs, unsupported architectures). New model files are picked up automatically. Works while the engine is stopped.

No parameters.

Structured result (`structuredContent`; the same JSON is also sent as text):

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `models` | array of ModelInfo | Usable and not-yet-usable models, default model first |
| `other_files` | array of OtherFile | Model files that aren't part of a usable model |

`ModelCapabilities`:

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `text_to_image` | boolean | Works with generate_image |
| `edit` | boolean | Works with edit_image |
| `max_side` | integer | Largest supported image side in pixels |
| `max_reference_images` | integer \| null | Most reference images edit_image accepts |
| `transparency` | boolean | Supports transparent=True |
| `text_rendering` | string \| null | How reliably it renders lettering: strong, good or weak |

`ModelDefaults`:

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `variant` | string | Which version of the family this file is: base, turbo or distilled |
| `steps` | integer | Sampling steps used when a request doesn't set steps |
| `cfg` | number | Guidance scale used when a request doesn't set cfg_scale |

`ModelFiles`:

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `unet` | string | Diffusion model file |
| `clip` | string \| null | Text encoder file (null if missing) |
| `vae` | string \| null | VAE file (null if missing) |

`ModelInfo`:

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | Pass as `model` to generate_image / edit_image |
| `family` | string | Model family, e.g. Qwen-Image 2.1 |
| `available` | boolean | All files present; usable now |
| `defaults` | ModelDefaults | Settings used unless a request overrides them |
| `capabilities` | ModelCapabilities | What the model can do |
| `files` | ModelFiles | Files the model runs with |
| `license` | string | The model's license (Pinaxium itself is MIT) |
| `notes` | string | How it compares: strengths, limits and relative speed, to choose a model |
| `missing` | array of string | Companion files needed before it can be used |

`OtherFile`:

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `file` | string | File name |
| `folder` | string | ComfyUI models subfolder it is in |
| `size_gb` | number | File size, GB |
| `note` | string | Why it isn't offered as a model |

### generate_image

**Generate image**

Generate an image from a text prompt. Waits for the render (starting the engine and loading the model first if needed) up to max_wait_s. The image is saved as a draft in `project`, recorded with its prompt, model and settings.

Reply, in order: a text block with the saved file's path, size and mode, the settings used (model, steps, seed, cfg), the project, the render time and the job_id; a resource link to the full-size PNG (pinaxium://images/<project>/<file>); and a preview (max 1024 px) unless include_preview is false. If the render is still running at max_wait_s, the reply is just the job_id for get_job.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | string | yes |  | non-empty | What to draw: a detailed natural-language description. Quoted text ("...") is rendered as lettering by models that can. |
| `model` | string \| null |  | `None` |  | A model id from list_models; the default model when omitted. |
| `negative_prompt` | string |  | `''` |  | Things to avoid. Only has an effect when cfg_scale > 1. |
| `width` | integer |  | `1024` | 256–2048 | Output width in pixels (rounded to a multiple of 16). Render time grows with pixel count. |
| `height` | integer |  | `1024` | 256–2048 | Output height in pixels (rounded to a multiple of 16). |
| `steps` | integer \| null |  | `None` | 1–100 | Sampling steps; the model's default when omitted. |
| `seed` | integer \| null |  | `None` | 0– | Fix for reproducible results; random when omitted (the seed used is reported). |
| `cfg_scale` | number \| null |  | `None` | 0.0–20.0 | Guidance scale; the model's default when omitted (1.0 for distilled/turbo models). |
| `transparent` | boolean |  | `False` |  | Keep an alpha channel (models with capabilities.transparency only); say 'transparent background' in the prompt. Otherwise results are plain RGB. |
| `project` | string |  | `'scratch'` |  | Project to keep this work in (created on first use). Drafts of one piece of work belong together so they can be finalized and cleaned up as a set; see list_projects. |
| `include_preview` | boolean |  | `True` |  | Return a downscaled preview (max 1024 px) of each saved image as image content, besides its path. |
| `max_wait_s` | number |  | `300` | 1–3600 | Seconds to wait for the render; if it isn't done by then a job_id is returned for get_job. |

### edit_image

**Edit image**

Edit an image, or compose a new one from several reference images, following an instruction (refer to them as image 1, image 2, ... in the order given). Only models whose capabilities.edit is true can do this, with at most their max_reference_images.

References can be any image file ComfyUI reads (PNG, JPEG, WebP), or pinaxium:// image URIs from earlier results; they're copied into the project's uploads folder. The output has the first reference's aspect ratio at about resolution x resolution pixels, is saved as a draft in `project`, and the reply is the same as generate_image's.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | string | yes |  | non-empty | The instruction, e.g. "make it night time" or "put the person from image 1 in the jacket from image 2". |
| `image_paths` | array of string | yes |  | 1–10 items | Reference images, as absolute paths or pinaxium:// image URIs (1 to the model's max_reference_images); the first sets the output's aspect ratio. |
| `model` | string \| null |  | `None` |  | A model id from list_models whose capabilities.edit is true; the default model when omitted. |
| `negative_prompt` | string |  | `''` |  | Things to avoid. Only has an effect when cfg_scale > 1. |
| `resolution` | integer |  | `1024` | 256–2048 | Output pixel budget as one side of a square (1024 means about 1 megapixel), at the first reference's aspect ratio. |
| `steps` | integer \| null |  | `None` | 1–100 | Sampling steps; the model's default when omitted. |
| `seed` | integer \| null |  | `None` | 0– | Fix for reproducible results; random when omitted (the seed used is reported). |
| `cfg_scale` | number \| null |  | `None` | 0.0–20.0 | Guidance scale; the model's default when omitted (1.0 for distilled/turbo models). |
| `transparent` | boolean |  | `False` |  | Keep an alpha channel (models with capabilities.transparency only); say 'transparent background' in the prompt. Otherwise results are plain RGB. |
| `project` | string |  | `'scratch'` |  | Project to keep this work in (created on first use). Drafts of one piece of work belong together so they can be finalized and cleaned up as a set; see list_projects. |
| `include_preview` | boolean |  | `True` |  | Return a downscaled preview (max 1024 px) of each saved image as image content, besides its path. |
| `max_wait_s` | number |  | `300` | 1–3600 | Seconds to wait for the render; if it isn't done by then a job_id is returned for get_job. |

### run_workflow

**Run ComfyUI workflow**

Run an arbitrary ComfyUI workflow, for models or features the built-in tools don't cover (LoRAs, ControlNet, unsupported architectures). The graph is ComfyUI's API format, as written by ComfyUI's "Export (API)". Its SaveImage nodes are pointed at the project's drafts folder (keeping their file name prefixes). Returns every image the workflow saved or previewed, like generate_image.

Unlike the other tools this is open-world and destructive: ComfyUI's bundled partner API nodes call external paid services (OpenAI, Google, Anthropic and others), installed custom nodes can run arbitrary code with network access, and nodes can write or overwrite files. The workflow runs exactly as given: use it only when the built-in tools can't do the job.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `workflow` | object | yes |  |  | ComfyUI API-format graph: {node_id: {"class_type": ..., "inputs": {...}}}. Model file names must match those shown by list_models. |
| `project` | string |  | `'scratch'` |  | Project to keep this work in (created on first use). Drafts of one piece of work belong together so they can be finalized and cleaned up as a set; see list_projects. |
| `include_preview` | boolean |  | `True` |  | Return a downscaled preview (max 1024 px) of each saved image as image content, besides its path. |
| `max_wait_s` | number |  | `300` | 1–3600 | Seconds to wait for the render; if it isn't done by then a job_id is returned for get_job. |

### get_job

**Get render result**

Check a render that outlived max_wait_s. Its state is queued, running, done (the reply then is the same as generate_image's), error (with ComfyUI's message) or unknown. Job state lives in the engine: once the engine has stopped, find the result with list_images instead.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `job_id` | string | yes |  | non-empty | The job_id returned by a render that outlived max_wait_s. |
| `include_preview` | boolean |  | `True` |  | Return a downscaled preview (max 1024 px) of each saved image as image content, besides its path. |

### cancel_render

**Cancel render**

Interrupt the render that is currently running; its result is lost. Queued jobs stay queued.

No parameters.

### list_projects

**List projects**

List all projects with how many drafts and finals each has, the drafts' disk use and last activity, plus where finals are kept and the automatic draft cleanup setting. Works while the engine is stopped.

No parameters.

Structured result (`structuredContent`; the same JSON is also sent as text):

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `projects` | array of ProjectEntry | All projects, by name |
| `finals_dir` | string | Folder holding every project's finals (setting finals_dir) |
| `draft_retention_days` | number | Unfinalized drafts older than this go to the recycle bin automatically; 0 = never |

`ProjectEntry`:

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | Project name (pass as `project`) |
| `uri` | string | The project's resource: its drafts and finals with provenance |
| `drafts` | integer | Working images in the project |
| `finals` | integer | Finals registered in the project |
| `draft_bytes` | integer | Disk space used by the drafts, bytes |
| `last_activity` | string \| null | Newest image's time, local, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS |

### list_drafts

**List drafts**

List draft images (working renders), newest first, one page at a time: URI, clickable links (file_uri, local_url), project, prompt, model, seed and, if it was finalized, its final's URI. Metadata only; look at one with view_image. Works while the engine is stopped.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | string \| null |  | `None` |  | Only this project; all projects when omitted. |
| `limit` | integer |  | `20` | 1–100 | Page size. |
| `offset` | integer |  | `0` | 0– | Items to skip: pass the previous page's next_offset. |

Structured result (`structuredContent`; the same JSON is also sent as text):

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `drafts` | array of DraftEntry | This page, newest first |
| `total` | integer | How many drafts match in all |
| `next_offset` | integer \| null | Pass as offset for the next page; null on the last page |

`DraftEntry`:

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `uri` | string | The draft's URI, pinaxium://projects/<project>/drafts/<file>: readable as a resource, usable wherever an image is accepted |
| `file_uri` | string | file:/// link to the image on this machine's disk: give it to the user as a clickable link |
| `local_url` | string \| null | http://127.0.0.1 link served by the Pinaxium service, opens in any browser on this machine; null when the service isn't running |
| `path` | string | Full path of the PNG |
| `project` | string | Project the draft belongs to |
| `final_uri` | string \| null | If this draft was finalized: its final's URI |
| `model` | string \| null | Model that made it, when known |
| `prompt` | string \| null | Prompt or instruction that made it, when known |
| `seed` | integer \| null | Seed used, when known |
| `modified` | string | Local time, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS |
| `bytes` | integer | File size in bytes |

### list_finals

**List finals**

Find finished artwork across projects, newest first, one page at a time: each final's permanent URI and id, title, description, tags, provenance (model, prompt, seed, what it was derived from). Metadata only unless thumbnails is true, which adds a single contact sheet of the page whose numbered tiles map one-to-one to the entries' sheet_number. Look at a chosen final with get_final; use it as a source with derive_from_final or as a reference in edit_image.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string \| null |  | `None` |  | Words that must all appear in a final's id, title, description, tags, prompt or project (case-insensitive). |
| `project` | string \| null |  | `None` |  | Only this project; all projects when omitted. |
| `limit` | integer |  | `20` | 1–100 | Page size. |
| `offset` | integer |  | `0` | 0– | Items to skip: pass the previous page's next_offset. |
| `thumbnails` | boolean |  | `False` |  | Also return one contact-sheet image of this page: tile #n is the entry with sheet_number n (labelled project/id). Small; use get_final to look closely. |

Structured result (`structuredContent`; the same JSON is also sent as text):

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `finals` | array of FinalEntry | This page, newest first |
| `total` | integer | How many finals match in all |
| `next_offset` | integer \| null | Pass as offset for the next page; null on the last page |

`FinalEntry`:

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | The final's permanent id within its project, e.g. portrait-001 |
| `uri` | string | Permanent URI, pinaxium://projects/<project>/finals/<id>: readable as a resource, usable wherever an image is accepted |
| `file_uri` | string \| null | file:/// link to the image on this machine's disk: give it to the user as a clickable link (null if the file can't be found) |
| `local_url` | string \| null | http://127.0.0.1 link served by the Pinaxium service, opens in any browser on this machine; null when the service isn't running |
| `project` | string | Project the final belongs to |
| `title` | string \| null | Title given at finalize_image |
| `description` | string \| null | Description given at finalize_image (by default the prompt) |
| `tags` | array of string | Tags given at finalize_image |
| `created` | string \| null | When it was finalized, local time |
| `model` | string \| null | Model that made it |
| `prompt` | string \| null | Prompt or instruction that made it |
| `seed` | integer \| null | Seed used |
| `derived_from` | string \| null | URI of the final it was derived from, if any |
| `source_draft` | string \| null | URI of the draft it was finalized from |
| `path` | string | Where the file is now (renames and moves inside the finals folder are followed); informational, refer to the final by its URI |
| `exists` | boolean | False if the file can't be found (moved outside the finals folder or deleted): relink_final it |
| `sheet_number` | integer \| null | With thumbnails: the number of this final's tile on the contact sheet |

### get_final

**Get final**

Return one final: its metadata (id, URI, title, description, tags, provenance) as text, then the image itself downscaled to max_side. The full-size file is the final's URI as a resource.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `final` | string | yes |  | non-empty | A final's URI, pinaxium://projects/<project>/finals/<id> (from list_finals or finalize_image). |
| `max_side` | integer |  | `1024` | 64–1568 | Longest side of the returned image in pixels. |

### finalize_image

**Finalize image**

Mark a draft as finished: copy it into its project's finals (finals_dir/<project>/<id>.png) under a permanent id and URI (pinaxium://projects/<project>/finals/<id>), with searchable title, description and tags and the draft's provenance. Finals are never deleted or overwritten by Pinaxium. Finalizing the same draft again returns its existing final.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `image` | string | yes |  | non-empty | The draft to keep: its pinaxium:// URI or file path. |
| `final_id` | string \| null |  | `None` |  | Permanent id within the project, e.g. 'portrait-001' (lowercased; letters, digits, dashes). The next final-NNN when omitted. Ids are never reused. |
| `title` | string \| null |  | `None` |  | Short human title. |
| `description` | string \| null |  | `None` |  | What it is, for search; the prompt when omitted. |
| `tags` | array of string \| null |  | `None` | 0–50 items | Search tags. |

Structured result (`structuredContent`; the same JSON is also sent as text):

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | Project of the final |
| `id` | string | The final's permanent id |
| `uri` | string | The final's permanent URI |
| `file_uri` | string | file:/// link to the image on this machine's disk: give it to the user as a clickable link |
| `local_url` | string \| null | http://127.0.0.1 link served by the Pinaxium service, opens in any browser on this machine; null when the service isn't running |
| `path` | string | Where the final's file is |
| `already_final` | boolean | True if this draft had already been finalized (nothing copied; the existing final is returned) |

### relink_final

**Relink final**

Tell Pinaxium where a final's file went after it was moved outside the finals folder (moves and renames inside it are followed automatically). The file must be that final: it carries the final's stamp, or its content is unchanged. The final keeps its id and URI.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `final` | string | yes |  | non-empty | A final's URI, pinaxium://projects/<project>/finals/<id> (from list_finals or finalize_image). |
| `path` | string | yes |  | non-empty | Where the final's file is now. |

Structured result (`structuredContent`; the same JSON is also sent as text):

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | Project of the final |
| `id` | string | The final's permanent id |
| `uri` | string | The final's permanent URI |
| `file_uri` | string | file:/// link to the image on this machine's disk: give it to the user as a clickable link |
| `local_url` | string \| null | http://127.0.0.1 link served by the Pinaxium service, opens in any browser on this machine; null when the service isn't running |
| `path` | string | Where the final's file is |
| `already_final` | boolean | True if this draft had already been finalized (nothing copied; the existing final is returned) |

### derive_from_final

**Derive from final**

Start a new branch from an existing final: an edit with the final as the source image. The result is a new draft (in the final's project, or any other); the final itself is never changed. Its provenance records the final's URI as derived_from, so lineage survives finalizing the new image too. The reply is the same as generate_image's.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `final` | string | yes |  | non-empty | A final's URI, pinaxium://projects/<project>/finals/<id> (from list_finals or finalize_image). |
| `instruction` | string | yes |  | non-empty | What to change or make from it, e.g. "same character, now in winter clothes". Refer to the final as image 1 and any extra references as image 2, 3, ... |
| `project` | string \| null |  | `None` |  | Project for the new draft (any project: start a new branch elsewhere); the final's own project when omitted. |
| `extra_references` | array of string \| null |  | `None` | 0–9 items | More reference images (URIs or paths) after the final. |
| `model` | string \| null |  | `None` |  | A model id with capabilities.edit; the default model when omitted. |
| `resolution` | integer |  | `1024` | 256–2048 | Output pixel budget as one side of a square, at the final's aspect ratio. |
| `steps` | integer \| null |  | `None` | 1–100 | Sampling steps; the model's default when omitted. |
| `seed` | integer \| null |  | `None` | 0– | Fix for reproducible results; random when omitted (the seed used is reported). |
| `cfg_scale` | number \| null |  | `None` | 0.0–20.0 | Guidance scale; the model's default when omitted (1.0 for distilled/turbo models). |
| `include_preview` | boolean |  | `True` |  | Return a downscaled preview (max 1024 px) of each saved image as image content, besides its path. |
| `max_wait_s` | number |  | `300` | 1–3600 | Seconds to wait for the render; if it isn't done by then a job_id is returned for get_job. |

### delete_images

**Delete drafts**

Send drafts to the OS recycle bin (restorable from there): the listed images, or all of a project's drafts and uploads. Give exactly one of images or project. Finals are never deleted and are reported as not deleted; so is anything outside Pinaxium's own folders, and any file the recycle bin refuses (there is no permanent delete). Finalize what you want to keep first.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `images` | array of string \| null |  | `None` | 0–500 items | Drafts to delete (URIs or paths). |
| `project` | string \| null |  | `None` |  | Delete every draft and uploaded reference of this project instead (its finals stay). |

Structured result (`structuredContent`; the same JSON is also sent as text):

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `deleted` | array of string | Files sent to the recycle bin |
| `not_deleted` | array of NotDeleted | Files left in place, with the reason |
| `note` | string | Where deleted files went |

`NotDeleted`:

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `image` | string | The image or file that was not deleted |
| `reason` | string | Why |

### view_image

**View image**

Look at a local image, e.g. a result, to check it before showing the user. Returns a text block with its path, full size and mode, then the image itself (JPEG, or PNG if it has transparency), downscaled to max_side. With crop, only that region is returned, at full resolution when it fits in max_side. Reads any image file this server's process can read, not only its own results.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes |  | non-empty | A local image file path, or a pinaxium:// draft or final URI. |
| `crop` | array of integer \| null |  | `None` | 4–4 items | Optional [x, y, width, height] in pixels of the full-size image, to inspect a detail (text, hands, faces) at full resolution. |
| `max_side` | integer |  | `1568` | 64–1568 | Longest side of the returned image in pixels. |

## Resources

| URI | Name | MIME type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pinaxium://engine/status` | Engine status | application/json | Same as the engine_status tool. Subscribe to be notified when the engine starts, stops, gets busy or loads models. |
| `pinaxium://logs/comfyui` | ComfyUI log | text/plain | Tail of the engine's log (last 256 KB): node errors, model loading, timings. |
| `pinaxium://logs/supervisor` | Supervisor log | text/plain | Tail of the engine supervisor's log: start, idle shutdown and spawn problems. |
| `pinaxium://projects/{project}/drafts/{filename}` (template) | Draft (full size) | image/png | A draft image, full size, by project and file name (see list_drafts). |
| `pinaxium://projects/{project}/finals/{final_id}` (template) | Final (full size) | image/png | A final image, full size, by project and permanent id (see list_finals). |
| `pinaxium://projects/{project}` (template) | Project | application/json | A project's drafts (with what made each) and finals (ids, metadata, provenance). Subscribe to hear when it changes. |

Resource capabilities: subscribe = true, listChanged = true. Saved images are listed individually by `resources/list` (newest 500) under `pinaxium://images/`.
